pages.text: &6Skyhaven.&r A village on a cloud, higher than anyone sensible would build one. The air is clean, the lanterns are lit, and for the first time in a long while you are in no hurry.
From the tavern across the square, a big man in an apron is waving both arms at you. That would be the innkeeper. It seems everyone in Skyhaven starts with him.
&7Walk over and right-click him to talk. Press &6K&7 to open your menu, and the &6Journal&7 keeps every quest. A &6gold !&7 over someone's head means they have something for you.
